_about: DEV-1 export, one outing; key names as in code; units in _units

_units.cs_ratio_f / cs_ratio_r: cornering stiffness ratio, dimensionless (local dFy/dalpha over the session reference slope; < 0 = past the peak of the Fy / Fz curve)
_units.stability_observed_Nm_per_deg: dMz/dbeta, N m / deg (negative = open-loop unstable yaw)
_units.health_score: fraction of NIS windows in band

car.notes: car is understeery and lacks rotation. Setup changes were stiffer rear arb and damping unkown

gate_d4l.note: K in (30, 35] = edge zone, status marginal by design (ruling 2026-10-20); K > 35 fails g2
gate_d4l.source: derived from the persisted manifest: K = B C mu with the gate's own formula; the g1 alpha span is not persisted (stripped by resolve_sideslip_beta)

full_manifest.front_force_frame: tyre frame (Goblirsch et al. 2025 Eq. 13), fit and observer

observer_q.method: held-over-step upper bound from the fit-L force residual (Level 2)
